title: Rune words
by: Dev (local model), checked by the writing room

items.name: Keen Flame
items.hint: Edge, then Ember, on a blade.

items.name: Gale Edge
items.hint: The wind first, and the cut it carries.

items.name: Rooted Oak
items.hint: Root into stone, on something you wear.

items.name: Stillwater
items.hint: The tide that meets a stone and stops.

items.name: Seer's Mark
items.hint: An eye for fortune, anywhere you carry it.

items.name: Singing Blade
items.hint: Two songs with the wind between them.

items.name: Thunderclap
items.hint: Storm, storm, and then the edge comes down.

items.name: Fallen Star
items.hint: The star falls, burns, and splits the sky.
